items.titleZh: ChatGPT 的计算机历史记录跟踪您的点击和击键
items.titleEn: ChatGPT’s Computer History tracks your clicks and keystrokes
items.summaryZh: The Verge AI 报道了人工智能的行业发展。消息来源的要点：macOS 上的 ChatGPT 桌面应用程序有一个名为“计算机历史记录”的新功能，可以将您的操作转化为训练数据、了解您的工作方式、建议自动化，甚至拾取您未完成的任务。
items.summaryEn: The Verge AI reports an industry development in AI. Key point from the source: ChatGPT's desktop app on macOS has a new feature called Computer History that turns your actions into training data, learning how you work, suggesting automations, and even picking up tasks you left half done.
